---
title: "Variables"
subtitle: "Every column in the clean files, with the question and answer text behind it"
---

The clean survey and canvassing files have one row per respondent. Most
columns are TRUE/FALSE answer columns from choose-all-that-apply questions
(`TRUE` chosen, `FALSE` seen but not chosen, `NA` not shown or skipped);
single-answer questions are ordered categories. This page is generated from
`data/processed/data-dictionary.csv`, which the cleaning program writes.

```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

dictionary <- read_csv(here("data/processed/data-dictionary.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    group = if_else(str_detect(column, "_"), str_extract(column, "^[^_]+"), column),
    # each question's columns keep their survey order; sections follow the questionnaire
    group = fct_inorder(group)
  )

section_title <- c(
  q1 = "q1 — Connection to care", q2a = "q2a — Challenges (current)",
  q3a = "q3a — Supports (current)", q4a = "q4a — Who helps (current)",
  q2b = "q2b — Challenges (future)", q3b = "q3b — Supports (future)",
  q2c = "q2c — Challenges (past)", q3c = "q3c — Supports (past)",
  q4c = "q4c — Who helped (past)", q2d = "q2d — Challenges (observer)",
  q3d = "q3d — Supports (observer)", q4d = "q4d — Who helps (observer)",
  q6 = "q6 — Ideal care", gender = "Gender", race = "Race and ethnicity",
  doorstep = "Doorstep challenges (canvassing)", hh_size = "Household size",
  hh_income = "Household income", age = "Age", disability = "Disability",
  political = "Political views", pathway = "Pathway (derived)",
  canvass_mode = "Canvassing mode", responded = "Responded (canvassing)",
  care_connection = "Care connection (canvassing screener)",
  continue_full = "Agreed to full questions (canvassing)"
)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
for (g in levels(dictionary$group)) {
  rows <- filter(dictionary, group == g)
  cat("## ", coalesce(unname(section_title[g]), g), "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("**Question:** ", rows$question[1], "\n\n", sep = "")
  if (all(rows$column == g)) {
    cat("**Column:** `", g, "` (ordered category)\n\n", sep = "")
    cat(knitr::kable(select(rows, Level = option)), sep = "\n")
  } else {
    cat(knitr::kable(select(rows, Column = column, `Answer text` = option)), sep = "\n")
  }
  cat("\n\n")
}
```
